# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 027 DOCTRINE RESEARCH
# ============================================================================
# Minor repeatable global doctrine curriculum. The root event creates one
# append-only country batch per live country with a valid adapter action.
# Human countries use the chained pages below; AI countries resolve through
# the same adapter pool in scripted effects.
# ============================================================================

add_namespace = chaosx.nr27

country_event = {
	id = chaosx.nr27.1
	title = chaosx.nr27.1.t
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		# Ordinary dispatch calls the owner transaction directly. The canonical
		# root is the console bridge, so its origin is a forced setup.
		set_global_flag = doctrine_research_achievement_forced_setup_used
		doctrine_research_fire_global_batch = yes
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = chaosx.nr27.14
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = { doctrine_research_wake_country_batches = yes }
}

country_event = {
	id = chaosx.nr27.3
	title = chaosx.nr27.3.t
	desc = {
		trigger = { check_variable = { doctrine_research_current_choice_number = 1 } }
		text = chaosx.nr27.3.d.opening
	}
	desc = { text = chaosx.nr27.3.d }
	picture = GFX_report_event_027_doctrine_research
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		has_country_flag = doctrine_research_active_batch
		is_ai = no
		doctrine_research_country_is_live = yes
	}
	immediate = { doctrine_research_prepare_domain_menu_display = yes }

	option = {
		name = chaosx.nr27.general_staff
		trigger = { doctrine_research_country_has_valid_action = yes }
		custom_effect_tooltip = chaosx.nr27.general_staff.tt
		hidden_effect = {
			doctrine_research_clear_selection = yes
			doctrine_research_delegate_active_batch = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = chaosx.nr27.3.army
		custom_effect_tooltip = chaosx.nr27.3.army.tt
		trigger = { doctrine_research_country_has_doctrine_system = yes doctrine_research_army_has_valid_action = yes }
		hidden_effect = {
			doctrine_research_clear_selection = yes
			set_variable = { doctrine_research_selected_domain = constant:doctrine_research_domain.army }
			if = {
				limit = { doctrine_research_selected_domain_adoption_available = yes }
				country_event = { id = chaosx.nr27.4 }
			}
			else = {
				doctrine_research_capture_selected_domain_grand_doctrine = yes
				country_event = { id = chaosx.nr27.5 }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = chaosx.nr27.3.navy
		custom_effect_tooltip = chaosx.nr27.3.navy.tt
		trigger = { doctrine_research_country_has_doctrine_system = yes doctrine_research_navy_has_valid_action = yes }
		hidden_effect = {
			doctrine_research_clear_selection = yes
			set_variable = { doctrine_research_selected_domain = constant:doctrine_research_domain.navy }
			if = {
				limit = { doctrine_research_selected_domain_adoption_available = yes }
				country_event = { id = chaosx.nr27.4 }
			}
			else = {
				doctrine_research_capture_selected_domain_grand_doctrine = yes
				country_event = { id = chaosx.nr27.5 }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					doctrine_research_country_has_doctrine_system = yes doctrine_research_air_has_valid_action = yes
				}
				AND = {
					doctrine_research_country_has_doctrine_system = yes doctrine_research_special_forces_has_valid_action = yes
				}
				AND = {
					doctrine_research_country_has_doctrine_system = yes doctrine_research_chaos_warfare_has_valid_action = yes
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = { doctrine_research_country_has_valid_action = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		name = chaosx_event_more_options
		custom_effect_tooltip = chaosx_event_more_options_tt
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = chaosx.nr27.92821 } }
	}

}
